en.html:
Those hours during the Noh performance were supposed to be for preparing our attack afterward. That plan was now accepting its own condolences.

Kya karein. And how much preparation could we make, really?

The attack did not even have to succeed. Fix the escape route. That much was sufficient.

ja.html:
予定では、能舞台が開かれる時間は、その後の作戦
決行の為の準備にあてるつもりだったのだが……。
　仕方もない。それに、準備と言ったところで大した
事ができるわけでもないのだ。

　元々、成功させる必要のない襲撃作戦である。
　退路の見定めだけ済ませておけば充分だった。

en.html:
Formal Noh, with all five categories from first to fifth—a gobandate—takes the whole day. Hard work for those performing, certainly. The spectators also do not get exemption from suffering.

Government work would be affected. Surely even here they would not go to that extent...

en.html:
Ichijou sounded thoroughly fed up. Just imagining that much sitting in one place had apparently exhausted her.

Personally, I preferred sitting to walking around. No great hardship from my side. But this girl was energy packed into human shape. Making it stay in one place would not be easy.

　それだけの時間、一箇所に座り続ける事を想像した

　歩き回るより座っている方が好きな俺にはさして苦
でもないが、この活力の塊のような娘には辛かろう。

The whisper was for my ears only. I understood and nodded.

...Principle would have its way, even over clothing.

But that was Ichijou Ayane. If her stubbornness could see her through the fatigue, who was I to keep objecting?

en.html:
Kageaki"Titles?"
Iwata"That is the curious part: they have not been announced. Only that there will be two pieces, one from the second category and one from the fourth."
Kageaki"Warrior play, then a miscellaneous Noh. Why hide the titles?"
Iwata"Who knows? It is the Lieutenant General of Koga we are talking about. Maybe again some flamboyant idea has come into his head."

岩田「それが、発表されていないのです。 　二番目物と四番目物の二番立であるとしか 知らされていません」
景明「修羅物と雑能ですか……。 　しかし、曲目を明かさないというのはまた、 何故」
岩田「さあ……？ 　他でもない古河中将様のことです。なにか また奇抜なことを考えていらっしゃるのかも」

Madam Iwata shrugged. From her manner, this monk-robed lord sending common sense on holiday was nothing new.

Even inviting junior officials to the Noh was unusual enough.

Basara Kubo. Apparently the flamboyance was not restricted to the name.
